base_duplicate_restore: git_path at base_commit has identical bytes; the original Library member remains the complete restore fallback.
lean_duplicate_restore: git_path in this additive proposal has identical bytes; restore to the original member path only after validating hashes.
library_version_limit: 156 archive identities have no version_id. The archive SHA-256 is mandatory; reject changed bytes rather than silently accepting the latest Library version.
